title: jahan hussain waha lailahaillalah
body:
jahan hussain waha lailahaillalah
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain hussain hussain
charaag jalta raha
jo qaafela tha rawaan wo qaafela hai rawaan
safar ba noke sina sina ke saath azaan
bureeda sar ki sadaayein fiza me phail gayi
dareechon aanganon galiyon me tapte sehra se
zameen o arsh khilaawon se aur fizaawon se
dinon me raat me jangal me kohsaaron se
sadaayein aane lagi ash'hado an la ilaaha illallah
ye ek baar huwa aur la zawaal huwa
sina ki nok pe subhaana rabbi al aala
pukaara kalma e tauheed bhi jazaak allah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain din bhi hai aur diniyaat bhi hai
hussain kalma e tauheed ki hayaat bhi hai
hussain ramze khuda bhi khuda sifaat bhi hai
hussain baara imaamon ki kaayenaat bhi hai
hussain se hai ayaan la illaha illallah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gaud fatema zehra ki ho ke rege tapaan
wo sehne kaaba ho pushte rasul ya ke sina
fazaaye jang ho ya ho payaame amn o amaan
na dekhein teer na talwaar gar ho hukme azaan
hussain ka hai bayaan la illaha illallah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain waalon ki pehchaan hai azaadaari
hussain waalon ki to jaan hai azaadaari
hussain waalon ka imaan hai azaadaari
hussain waalon ka elaan hai azaadaari
hussainiyat ki zabaan la ilaha illallah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
basi hai karbobala to koyi jawaaz bhi hai
luta hai gulshane zahra to koyi raaz bhi hai
ye raaz wo hai ke khaaliq ko is pe naaz bhi hai
baraaye naaz bahattar ki wo namaaz bhi hai
isi ka sirre nihaan la ilaha illallah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
namaaz nafs ki izzat hai auliya ki qasam
namaaz din ki hurmat hai ausiya ki qasam
namaaz husne sharaafat hai ambiya ki qasam
namaaz qissa e wahdat hai kibriya ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
namaaz khaire amal ki taraf bulaati hai
namaaz ishqe khuda ka hunar sikhaati hai
namaaz abd ko mabud se milaati hai
namaaz guftugu allah se karaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi namaaz gunaahon se bhi bachaati hai
namaz qabr talak saath saath jaati hai
la illaha illallah
namaaz wo hai jo faaqon me mustafa  ne parhi
<<DIVIDER>>
jaga ke apne hi qaatil ko murtaza  ne parhi
jo chakiyon ki mushaqat me fatema  ne parhi
gale laga ke zahar ko jo mujtaba  ne parhi
jo chaahta hai ke azmat namaaz ki dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
mere hussain  ka wo sajda akhri dekhe
parhi namaaz jo aabid  ne pushte naaqa par
adaa kiya jise baaqir  ne sakhtiyaan seh kar
bayaan kiya jise jaafar  ne bar sare mimbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ruku me barson rahe jiske kaazime muztar
raza  ne lab pe sari ar reza sajaa ke parhi
taqi ne taqwa e butaalebi bataa ke parhi
naqi ne naqwate baatil mita mita ke parhi aur askari ne khabar aakhri suna ke parhi
<<DIVIDER>>
pase namaaz musalle pe ro raha koyi
imaame asr hai aur hujjate khuda hai wohi
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khaimagaah wo saydaaniyaan wo zikre khuda
jahaan musalle pe zainab rabaab aur fizza
hasan ki bewaa ruqayya sakina ka sajda
tamaam bibiyaan karti thi sirf ek dua
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khuda hame manzur kehte aab rahe
hussain apne iraadon me kaameyaab rahe
sadaa e tishna labaan la illa ha illallah
<<MINI>>
jahaan hussain wahaan la illa ha illallah
<<DIVIDER>>
khateebe noke sina la illa ha illallah magar namaaz se putcho ke karbala kya hai
hussain aur tera rishta e wafa kya hai
kaha namaaz ne sunlo meri baqaa kya hai
bas ek sajda e shabbir ke siwa kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain hi ka gharaana bacha gaya mujhko
wo khud ujarh gaya lekin sajaa gaya mujhko
mayaane karbobala aah maine kya dekha
ghera la’eenon me kunba rasul ka dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
butul zaadon ko be aab o be ghazaa dekha
bahaata paani udhar lashkare jafaa dekha
namaaz parhte rahe dil me isteraab na tha
guzar gaye the kayi din ke ghar me aab na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
bataawun kaise ke daswi ko maine kya dekha
sahar huwi to shahaadat ka silsila dekha
kisi ka sina to zakhmi koyi gala dekha
labe faraat alam khun me bhara dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain laashon pe laashen yuhi uthaate rahe aur apni raahe shahaadat ki samt jaate rahe
kamar ruku’ ki tarha thi magar hussain uthe ke ehle zulm pe laazimtha ab ke tegh chale
ghazab ki tegh chali koyi rokta kaise
imaame waqt the allah ki riza pe ruke
<<DIVIDER>>
azaane asr suni
azaane asr suni dekha aalame baala
kaha hussain ne subhaana rabbi al aala
aayi sadaa e ghaib ibaadat ka waqt hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay fatema ke laal telaawat ka waqt hai
jannat me saf bandhi hai imaamat ka waqt hai
bas bas hussain bas ye ibaadat ka waqt hai
rakhli mayaan me shahe waala ne zulfeqaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh gauf bandhe aaye qamadar das hazaar
Woh beshumar tego ke phal aur ek Hussain
Woh sekdo payame ajal aur ek Hussain
Dube huwe the khoon me geso Hussain ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Teron ne chaan daale the pehloo Hussain ke
Naize kabhi naize ke pehlo pe kiya waar
Qandhe pe chale saas zara rakibe talwar
Na waqt beni kahil ka kaleja pe hiwa waar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazoo me dar aya sabare khuliye khukhaar
Tege ubhi huwi jo barabar se chal gayi
Khyrunnisa ka maha laka khaaq par gira
Reti pe mustafa ke jigar ka lahoo gira
<<DIVIDER>>
Sayed ki gira Imam gira ke khoon gira
Woh zulm wo raha tha ke duniya ulatti thi
Jab zere teg gardane Shabbir katti thi
Woh khuldah teg zaigamo Zehra pe chalti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam kunah namaz thi aur khoon roti thi
Jaari thi yeh sadae nabi ka nawasa hoon
Amma pilao paani main pyaasa hu...2
Ya Hussain...x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajab ada se jab namazi namaz padhe kar gaya
Behan ke saamne noke sina pe chadhke gaya
Nazar main bhai ke sajdon ki aabotab jo thi
Behen sar khule makhtal me maghrebain padhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazar ke saamne har mahelaqa ki laash rahi
Gham e Hussain ki barchi utha gayi Zainab Magar namaz ki duniya basa gayi Zainab
